Ready to join the sweetest team in town as a production employee? 🍪 At Merba, you'll work in the packing department. You and your colleagues make sure every box of cookies looks perfect! Together you keep the production line running smoothly. And solve small issues before they turn into big ones!

There's more. Because you will learn everything about working in a cookie factory! From mixing dough to working with the chocolate lines or ovens. You'll soon know it all . Maybe even grow further to be the new machine operator! 🚀

You'll work in 3 shifts:
🕕 06:00 - 14:00
🕑 14:00 - 22:00
🌙 22:00 - 06:00

At Merba you're guaranteed to work at least 3 days per week. On top of that, there are 2 reserved shifts. So if it gets busy, you might get called in for some extra hours. Perfect for anyone who likes some flexibility. And wants to earn some extra dough! 💸
